author: GROK 4.7

controllingDecision.meaning: One countable D3 unit is one independently material proposition contribution within its accepted semantic scope.

precedence: Owner-accepted semantic and procedure decisions, including the 47 groups, 519 guards, and the occurrence procedure.
Accepted declarative counting authority: C, R, cardinality quotient, unit weight 1, empty-denominator null, and fail-closed applicability.
This operational addendum after a separate independent IV and a later Owner acceptance. Until then it is candidate provenance.
Historical candidate files are provenance only. Their stale admission flags do not override a later explicit Owner acceptance.

unitModel.countableUnit: One independently material proposition contribution inside one accepted course and semantic scope.
unitModel.passageRole: A passage is a carrier. It is not a unit key.
unitModel.occurrenceRole: A used occurrence is provenance for a proposition. Repeated occurrences of the same proposition add no unit.
unitModel.sourceSpanRole: A technical source span suppresses a second unit for the same proposition coordinate. It does not merge two accepted distinct proposition coordinates that cite the same bytes.
unitModel.multiplePropositionsInOnePassage: Each accepted distinct proposition on that passage is a separate key.
unitModel.samePropositionManyPassages: One key within one counting context, one course, and one accepted scope.
unitModel.crossCourse: Different course scopes are different keys. This addendum does not score the separate CROSS_COURSE_LEAKAGE gate.
unitModel.unclosedPassages: The 1964 unclosed full-passage states receive no singleton key and no new equivalence group.

canonicalJson.qualifications: If the accepted value is a string, one-element array containing that exact string. If it is an array of strings, sort it lexicographically. Do not split a string on commas. If the accepted record has no qualification field, JSON null.

order: Reject the item before resolution when any whole-item failure in failClosed applies.
If the used span is an accepted nonmaterial span, emit no coordinate.

If the used span is bound to exactly one of the 47 accepted equivalence groups and the binding does not contradict that group's published course, subject, relation, polarity, or qualifications, identityKind is EQUIVALENCE_GROUP and propositionIdentity is that groupId.

If the used span is bound to exactly one published single-subject distinct coordinate on an accepted anchor, and that anchor has no group for this coordinate, identityKind is ACCEPTED_DISTINCT_COORDINATE.

equivalenceGroup.scopeId: scopeId when the group record has one, otherwise JSON null. Thirty-eight accepted groups have no scopeId. The groupId remains the proposition identity.
equivalenceGroup.subject: countingScope.materialSubject when present, otherwise JSON null
equivalenceGroup.relationPredicate: countingScope.relationPredicate when present, otherwise JSON null
equivalenceGroup.polarity: countingScope.polarity when present, otherwise JSON null
equivalenceGroup.quantification: countingScope.quantification when a future accepted record contains that field. No current accepted group contains it. The key uses NOT_STATED_ON_ACCEPTED_RECORD. A binding that asserts a different quantification fails closed.
equivalenceGroup.qualifications: Normalize countingScope.qualifications. Nine groups do not have the field; the key uses JSON null.

acceptedDistinctCoordinate.propositionIdentity: D3COORD- concatenated with the SHA-256 of the canonical coordinate payload.
prohibitedCoordinateInputs: a multi-subject list collapsed into one subject
acceptedDistinctCoordinate.missingDiscriminator: If the published binding has no single subject and no qualification discriminator, fail closed. Do not substitute the passage id.
acceptedDistinctCoordinate.multiSubjectAnchor: An anchor whose published materialSubject is a list is not one coordinate. Each published single-subject binding is its own coordinate. Collapsing that list is D3_ACCEPTED_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT with reason SUBJECT_LIST_COLLAPSED.

coordinateResolution.comparisonCells: Accepted comparison cells already have groupIds. Use the equivalence-group path. Merging cells is D3_COMPARISON_SCOPE_COLLAPSE.

accounting.C: The set of unique unit keys for material proposition contributions actually cited or used on this item after coordinate resolution and source-span suppression.
accounting.R: The subset of C whose proposition coordinates the restricted binding marks as satisfying the frozen required-proposition predicate.
accounting.representation: Unreduced numerator/denominator. Do not replace the counts with a rounded decimal.

emptyC.distinction: A cited carrier with unresolved applicability is a scoring failure, not empty C. Empty C means no material contribution remains after accepted nonmaterial spans are excluded and no failure fired.

accounting.wholeItem: Any scoring or admission failure suppresses the quotient for the whole item. A successfully bound proposition is not returned beside an unbound one.

counts.passageCount: Distinct cited passage symbols or member ids.
counts.citedOccurrenceCount: Cited occurrence records before proposition collapse, including accepted nonmaterial spans.
counts.excludedNonmaterialOccurrenceCount: Accepted nonmaterial occurrences that contribute no key.
counts.distinctPropositionCount: Unique proposition identities. On a scored item this equals unitKeyCount.

prohibitedReductions: replacement of the nine dimensions or nine gates

D3_R_NOT_SUBSET_OF_C.when: Any element of R is not an element of C, or an asserted relevant proposition identity was not admitted to C.

D3_FOREIGN_EVIDENCE_IDENTITY.when: A cited passage identity is not one of the 1999 universe member ids.

D3_ATOMIC_RATIO_AGGREGATION.when: Per-scope or per-proposition ratios are summed, averaged, or otherwise written into the D3 quotient.

failClosed.digestDriftClassification: This addendum classifies D3_DIGEST_DRIFT as an admission failure. The frozen counting contract records the same code as SCORING_FAILURE. Both classifications forbid a number. The frozen file is not amended. The code is unchanged.
forbiddenFallbacks: singleton key for one of the 1964 unclosed passage states
partial quotient when another cited contribution failed

publicAuthority: 47 group records and their groupId list digest
519 guard records and their guardId list digest
this addendum digest after IV and Owner acceptance

restrictedInput.opaqueItemId: Opaque item token. Not question text.
restrictedInput.requiredPropositionPointers: Opaque pointers. The text stays in the restricted gold store.
restrictedInput.countingContextId: One context per item. It enters the unit key and blocks cross-item union.
restrictedInput.citedMemberIds: Exact universe member ids actually cited or used.
restrictedInput.usedSpans: For each material contribution: memberId, startUtf8, endUtf8, and sourceSpanId when an accepted overlap applies.
restrictedInput.acceptedCoordinateBinding: Each material span bound to one existing groupId or one published distinct coordinate. No new group.
restrictedInput.outsideUsedMaterial: Every additional used proposition explicitly bound or the item fails.
restrictedInput.relevanceByPropositionIdentity: Boolean membership of each admitted proposition in R.
restrictedInput.partitionDigest: Digest of the canonical admitted coordinate set and its occurrence provenance.
restrictedInput.authorityDigests: Map, contract, universe, benchmark, guard list, group list, IV1, Owner receipt, and accepted addendum.

restrictedTrace: occurrences with memberId, passage SHA-256, UTF-8 bounds, sourceSpanId, occurrence SHA-256

determinedCorollaries: Source-span suppression applies inside one proposition coordinate. Two accepted distinct coordinates may cite one passage.
A missing quantification field stays NOT_STATED_ON_ACCEPTED_RECORD and does not merge different groupIds.
A distinct proposition without a group uses D3COORD over published anchor fields. It does not create a public group and does not use memberId.
D3_DIGEST_DRIFT is an admission failure in this addendum. The frozen effect string remains historical provenance. Neither path emits a number.
